content: Back before South Arlington got developed, it was a ranch.  The particular ranch was a peacock ranch.  The owner of the ranch went into debt and ran away rather than pay the bill.  So the peacocks became free range and went places other than the ranch.  When houses started being built in the area, the birds would come and go as they used to.  Eventually the owners of the houses just started feeding them.  They live and eat bugs in peoples yards.  That part of Arlington also has a large green space.

author: austinbaustinb
content:
and then also this whole update is based on better language understanding. one of the methods is called "fuzzy matching" which essentially allows us to score each message from 0 to 100 instead of just a Yes or No.

a website that kinda explains it is:
https://dataladder.com/fuzzy-matching-101/
but essentially we have a few key 'forbidden' phrases, which if you match perfectly, would be a 100% grade. However, if you're off by like one word or a letter or whatever, you may be graded like "80% of the forbidden phrase".
We can then decide a cutoff of "anything above 90% is spam"

so we get a little extra flexibility and it'll catch more edge cases.
But also it in theory would have more false positives.
so thats why I am allowing the 'due paying members' and 'server booster' roles as overwrites for that. You can say whatever if you have one of those two roles. But if not, you could be flagged. It won't kick anyone or whatever but may delete messages
